# Project-results database

Use `project-results.csv` (one row per metric per project) to build a verified portfolio. Nothing goes on the website unless the row is complete and verified.

## Standard metrics

| Metric | Unit | How to calculate | Typical evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Productivity improvement | output per labour-hour or per shift | output ÷ labour hours, same product mix | production log, attendance |
| Cost savings | INR per month / year | (baseline cost − new cost) × volume; state what is included | finance sign-off |
| Reduced rejection | % or PPM | rejected ÷ produced | quality register |
| Reduced cycle time | seconds / minutes | time study, same operation | time-study sheet |
| Reduced lead time | days / hours | order release to dispatch | ERP or dispatch log |
| Improved OEE | % | availability × performance × quality | OEE sheet with loss data |
| Reduced inventory | days / INR / pieces | average on-hand, same period length | stock report |
| Improved quality | complaints, first-pass yield, Cpk | per agreed definition | complaint log, SPC data |

## Rules before publication

1. **Label** every engagement: `Client Work` (completed for a paying/agreeing client), `Capability` (built or run internally), or `Example` (illustrative only).
2. **Baseline and result** use the same definition, unit and period length.
3. **Evidence reference** points to a record the company can produce on request.
4. **Client permission** is written (email or signed form) and names what may be published: client name, logo, numbers, quotes, photos.
5. **Verified by** is a named Leanova person who checked the evidence; verified date is recorded.
6. Rounded or anonymised figures are fine ("a Tier-2 auto component supplier in Telangana") if the client prefers.
7. Testimonials are copied word-for-word from the client and approved by them. Never edited into new claims.
